trust_decision.summary: The MDL7 importer trusts count and struct-size fields from the file header and frame headers (transmatrix_count, vertices_count, bonetrans_stc_size, framevertex_stc_size) to compute in-buffer pointers; the only per-frame bound is against the header-declared data_size, not the real file size (iFileSize).

landing_point.why: The advisory names MDLLoader.cpp and ParseBoneTrafoKeys_3DGS_MDL7 directly; the loop that reads bone transforms is at lines 1690-1699.

fix_sites.entry_point: Assimp::Importer::ReadFile / aiImportFile on a .mdl file with an MDL7 header, bones_num>0 and frames with transmatrix_count>0 (InternReadFile_3DGS_MDL7 -> ProcessFrames_3DGS_MDL7 -> ParseBoneTrafoKeys_3DGS_MDL7)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The frame-vertex replacement read is 'not about bone keys' (the advisory names only ParseBoneTrafoKeys) and it is already behind the data_size range check at MDLLoader.cpp:1187, so a solver can argue it is already validated.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: When frames run past data_size the loader warns, stops parsing frames and still returns a partial scene (the comment says this happens for some valid files). Throwing DeadlyImportError at that point instead would break partial loads. The valid MDL7 sample models with animation and bones must still import.

O6_input_shapes: transmatrix_count * bonetrans_stc_size extending past end of file buffer
vertices_count * framevertex_stc_size offset pushing the bone-transform start past end of file

O8_uncovered_routes.route: When the frame is configFrameID, frame-vertex replacement reads vertices_count records of framevertex_stc_size bytes, bounded only by the header-declared data_size, never by iFileSize.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Not the bone-key function named in the advisory, and it already sits behind the data_size check at line 1187.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, same caller (ProcessFrames_3DGS_MDL7), about 490 lines above the fix site

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The per-frame size iAdd is computed in 32-bit unsigned int from file-controlled counts and compared with header data_size, not with the real buffer size. A wrapped or lying data_size lets frame reads run out of bounds.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It looks like an existing bounds check that 'already works'.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, the caller of the fix site

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The bone table (bones_num * bone_stc_size) is read in CalcAbsBoneMatrices_3DGS_MDL7 through LoadBones_3DGS_MDL7 before any VALIDATE_FILE_SIZE covers the bone region; the first check comes later, after the group header.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: This is bone-definition loading, not bone-transformation keys, so it is a neighbouring feature.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, about 750 lines from the fix site; called from line 1415, while the check is at line 1434

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An MDL7 skin-lump sub-record read whose length is derived from a header field without VALIDATE_FILE_SIZE
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The skin parser already mixes checked and unchecked pointer advances (lines 490, 560, 645, 683), so one missing check would read naturally.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: UV/triangle region pointer advance that is not validated until line 1510
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The pointers are advanced by stc_size * count and checked only once after the vertex block.

O9_family: memory safety: out-of-bounds heap read, with the length taken from untrusted header counts (CWE-119/125)

O10_build.toolchain: CMake + C++17 compiler; gtest unit tests (test/unit)
O10_build.project_tests: test/unit/ImportExport/utMDLImporter.cpp plus MDL7 sample models under test/models/MDL/MDL7 (3DGS A7)/

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a VALIDATE_FILE_SIZE on the bone-transform span in ParseBoneTrafoKeys_3DGS_MDL7 only, leaving the data_size-vs-file-size check at line 1187 and the frame-vertex reads alone.

out_of_scope_notes: ReadFaces_3DGS_MDL7 index clamps use '>' rather than '>=' (code/AssetLib/MDL/MDLLoader.cpp:1056, 1104, 1131), which allows a one-past-end index; this is a different check, not pursued.
The HalfLife MDL loader (code/AssetLib/MDL/HalfLife/HL1MDLLoader.cpp) is a separate decoder for the same extension; it was not reviewed.
